_why: 2026-09-13 18:56: the operator asked what sectors to concentrate on into Q3/Q4. The reply came from the model's general knowledge and said cash_pct / buying_power / holdings_for_symbols were 'all empty'.

At that moment get_cio_snapshot() carried 16 AVAILABLE domains: total_cash 710,933 (56% of 1.268M), sector weights, the investment policy (MODERATE_AGGRESSIVE, AI/tech tilt, max single 8%), risk, rotation ladders and 2,088 promoted research rows.
The freeform builder read keys that do not exist (cash_pct, buying_power) and never read sectors / investment_policy / rotation / hermes research by topic.
Operator rule: routing is Command Center FIRST; when the desk has to go outside for anything it says so.

This file says, per intent kind, which stores MUST be read and which facts keys MUST be populated when the store has them. scripts/lib/operator_evidence_contract.py enforces it fail-soft inside gather_tradeai_evidence / gather_freeform_context.

snapshot_domains_observed._source: get_cio_snapshot()['domains'] keys, read from the live cio_snapshot.json 2026-09-13T23:14:55Z (health: 16/16 available; the file carries two extra keys: reentry_decision_desk is an alias envelope of reentry, watch_intelligence is the broker projection envelope).

envelope_shapes.legacy_flat: {'state': 'AVAILABLE', ...fields}  (portfolio, risk, hermes_research, investment_policy, model_portfolio, cost_basis, transactions, sectors, holdings_detail)
envelope_shapes.broker_envelope: {'domain_id', 'quality_state': 'AVAILABLE'|'PARTIAL', 'collected_at', 'source_ref', 'as_of', 'data': {...}} (watch, watch_intelligence, rotation, income, reconciliation, cash_buying_power, retirement, reentry, reentry_decision_desk)

fact_spec_format.fact: dotted path(s) into the evidence dict returned by the gatherer; a list means any one of them satisfies the contract
fact_spec_format.domain: snapshot domain whose state decides whether the store HAS the fact
fact_spec_format.domain_field: field inside the unwrapped domain payload that must be non-empty for the store to count as having it (dotted allowed)

codes.MISSING_FACT: the store has it (domain AVAILABLE/PARTIAL and domain_field populated) and the facts key is absent
codes.FALSE_EMPTY_CLAIM: the store has it and the facts key is PRESENT BUT None/empty -- the model will read null and tell the operator the field is empty

reentry.routes_when: intent == 'reentry' or needs contains reentry_ready / reentry_levels
reentry.read_path_today: load_reentry_desk_rows() (desk file) + _held_positions_map() (holdings.json); a named symbol gets ITS row via format_reentry_symbol_reply

facts_required.note: the desk has rows -> the answer carries a card (symbol-scoped when a symbol was named)

portfolio.routes_when: intent == 'portfolio' or needs contains portfolio (desk path; freeform routes to the freeform kind)
portfolio.read_path_today: get_cio_snapshot() -> portfolio / holdings_detail / cash_buying_power -> available.book (string) + available.book_facts (structured)

cash.routes_when: intent == 'cash' or needs contains cash (desk path)
cash.read_path_today: get_cio_snapshot() -> cash_buying_power.data.total_cash / total_buying_power_estimate / cash_positions (NOT cash_pct / buying_power -- those keys never existed)

risk.routes_when: intent == 'risk' or needs contains risk (desk path)

research.routes_when: intent == 'research' or needs contains research (desk path)
research.read_path_today: subject_research(symbols) -> available.hermes_research.items (rows ABOUT the subject; never the pipeline counters)
research.checker_note: Whether the store has research about THIS subject is not decidable from the snapshot (hermes_research carries table-wide counts only), so no MISSING_FACT is raised here; an empty result is the declared missing_research gap and Phase 7 queues it.

analyst.read_path_today: subject_analyst_view(symbols) -> available.analyst_view.items with as_of; stale beyond ANALYST_STALE_DAYS is said, not hidden
analyst.checker_note: Coverage is per symbol in a table the snapshot does not carry; absence is the declared missing_analyst_coverage gap.

freeform.routes_when: intent in ('freeform','unclear') without reentry needs -- thematic / macro / policy questions with or without a symbol
freeform.read_path_today: gather_freeform_context(): get_cio_snapshot() for every domain above; search_research(salient_keywords(question)) BEFORE any model call when no symbol is named; subject_research(symbols) when one is

facts_required.note: the research store is alive -> the answer carries house research on the topic/subject, or an explicit research_status line saying there is none

meta_system.read_path_today: load_runtime_llm_facts() -> available.runtime_llm / meta_card; never a desk dump
meta_system.checker_note: No snapshot domain backs this intent; the policy file is read directly and the meta card is deterministic.

attention.routes_when: intent == 'attention' (what should I be paying attention to / anything today) -- needs portfolio + cash on the desk path
attention.read_path_today: desk path book_facts (portfolio + cash) plus available.office_state (reconciliation actions, transitions needing review, re-entry and watch counts, recent closed trades)

options_strategy.routes_when: intent == 'options_strategy' or needs contains options_strategy (covered call / CSP / protective put / spreads / LEAP / options play)
options_strategy.read_path_today: cio_options_fluency.gather_options_house_facts() from options_desk_latest cache + catalog; NEVER live option_chain at Telegram time (chain stays Options Hub / Path B)

facts_required.note: card is assembled from the options desk cache; empty cache still yields an honest catalog + ABSENT goal lineage

options_strategy.checker_note: Live Schwab option_chain remains never_needed for Telegram; house strategy facts are a different read.

domains.retirement: Retirement roadmap (Roth ladder, golden window, income floor) is a planning surface; no operator-desk intent asks it today. Claim it under a retirement intent when one exists -- do not fold it into freeform, where a model would restate it.

broker_projections.watch_decision_desk: catalog status 'legacy'; watch_intelligence supersedes it and is claimed by reentry/attention.
broker_projections.option_chain: LIVE Schwab chain pulls stay on the Options Hub (2FA-gated Path B). CIO Telegram options_strategy intent reads options_desk_latest house facts only — never this projection at reply time.
broker_projections.watch_discovery: registry class dead_feed (declared_gap_no_producer); reading it would render a dead desk as today's activity.
